assistant:  It's important to communicate your preferences and boundaries to your team and manager. Here's a possible way to express your thoughts:

Subject: Preference Regarding Team-Building Activities

Dear [Team/Manager],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to bring up a personal preference regarding team-building activities. While I value the importance of bonding and collaborating with my colleagues, I strongly prefer not to participate in team-building activities that involve physical contact, such as sports or games.

This preference is due to a variety of reasons, including personal comfort, physical limitations, and a desire to ensure that everyone on the team feels included and comfortable. I believe that there are many alternative team-building activities that can foster camaraderie and collaboration without requiring physical contact.

I would greatly appreciate it if you could take my preference into account when planning future team-building activities. I am more than happy to suggest alternative ideas or participate in activities that align with my comfort level.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
